environment.description: Same Actix-web service deployed behind AWS API Gateway (REST API, regional endpoint) with a request validator attached to the POST /api/v1/upload method. The method integration uses a request body model (content type: multipart/form-data) with a JSON schema transformation via a VTL mapping template that enforces the 'filename' field in the Content-Disposition header matches the pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{1,64}\.zip$ before forwarding to the backend. Requests where the multipart boundary parsing extracts a filename containing path separators (/, \, ..) are rejected with 400 at the gateway level. Additionally, the API Gateway has a usage plan with request body size limit of 5MB and the mapping template explicitly strips and re-encodes the filename field, replacing the original Content-Disposition filename with a UUID-based name before the request reaches the Actix service. The backend VPC link connects to the service via a private ALB on port 8080.
